data.body: **P1 — Do not publish the outcome when MDC restoration failed.** Because this completion runs in `finally`, a `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` from `restore.close()` on an asynchronous executor kills only the worker while the caller receives normal success/PENDING. An ordinary inline failure is likewise suppressed later and can leave caller MDC altered. Capture the restoration failure first, complete the caller exceptionally for fatal failures, and propagate or recover ordinary restoration failures before publishing the result.
